apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 182 addresses Metal 4 panning stutter in both direct HDR and MetalFX effects paths. Consecutive submissions no longer wait on their own same-renderer shared event. MetalFX decoder visibility waits are narrowed to blit stages, and the queue-wide end-of-frame barrier is removed; drawable completion still uses signalDrawable/present. Retains the Mobile Game touch preset, independent button placement, split movement/look controls, rim-triggered sprint, Aim + Fire, immersive stream controls, ProMotion 120 FPS pacing and Metal 4/MetalFX rendering. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.
